chefs-knife.name: Chef's knife
chefs-knife.blurb: The one tool that touches everything. Pinch grip, weight forward, and it quietly does ninety percent of the kitchen's work.

cutting-board.name: Cutting board
cutting-board.blurb: Wood or plastic, never glass - glass dulls edges and hates your knife back. Own two: one for alliums, one for fruit.

mandoline.name: Mandoline
mandoline.blurb: Paper-thin slices at machine speed, and zero mercy for fingertips. Use the guard. Always use the guard.

box-grater.name: Box grater
box-grater.blurb: Four sides, four opinions. The coarse face is for cheese mountains; the small one is for nutmeg grudges.

microplane.name: Microplane / zester
microplane.blurb: Turns hard cheese to snow and citrus zest to perfume. A carpenter's rasp that defected to the kitchen, luckily.

pepper-mill.name: Pepper mill
pepper-mill.blurb: Ground pepper goes stale in minutes. The mill is the difference between seasoning and decoration.

cast-iron-skillet.name: Cast-iron skillet
cast-iron-skillet.blurb: Slow to heat, impossible to scare. It holds temperature when cold meat hits the pan, which is where crusts come from.

frying-pan.name: Frying pan / saute pan
frying-pan.blurb: The everyday workhorse - wide, flat sides, and honest about how much oil you actually poured.

dutch-oven.name: Dutch oven
dutch-oven.blurb: The heavy lidded pot that braises, fries, bakes bread and outlives its owner. Buy once, will it to someone.

stockpot.name: Stockpot
stockpot.blurb: Tall and patient - built for broths, blanching, and boiling pasta water like you mean it. Salt it like the sea.

saucepan.name: Saucepan
saucepan.blurb: Where sauces, rice and custards happen. The tall sides slow evaporation on purpose - that is the feature.

wok.name: Wok
wok.blurb: Curved, thin, screaming hot. A round bottom loves fire; a flat bottom forgives electric stoves. Either way: mise en place or perish.

paella-pan.name: Paella pan
paella-pan.blurb: Wide, shallow, dented steel. Maximum rice touching the bottom is the entire design brief - that is where the socarrat lives.

baking-dish.name: Baking dish
baking-dish.blurb: Ceramic or glass, goes oven-to-table, and hosts every gratin, mac and shepherd's pie you will ever love.

ramekin.name: Ramekins
ramekin.blurb: Small ceramic cups with big jobs: creme brulee, lava cake, and mise en place for adults.

oven.name: Oven
oven.blurb: The room where nothing is stirred. Every oven has hot spots; learn yours - they are characters.

stove.name: Stovetop
stove.blurb: Gas forgives, induction responds, electric insists. Learn which one you married.

grill.name: Grill / grill pan
grill.blurb: Char is a flavor, not a mistake. A grill pan gives you the stripes and part of the smoke, indoors, year-round.

skewers.name: Skewers
skewers.blurb: Soak the wooden ones for thirty minutes or watch them burn - a small ritual that protects big flavor.

blowtorch.name: Kitchen torch
blowtorch.blurb: The only tool that announces dessert is not done until something is caramelized. Keep it moving, 5 cm from the sugar.

thermometer.name: Instant-read thermometer
thermometer.blurb: Ends the guessing career of overcooked chicken, shy custards and lukewarm oil. The cheapest upgrade in the kitchen.

kitchen-scale.name: Kitchen scale
kitchen-scale.blurb: Grams do not argue. Baking's entire personality is a scale; everything else is vibes and apology.

measuring-cups.name: Measuring cups & spoons
measuring-cups.blurb: For cooks who level the spoon with a finger. No judgment. Some judgment.

mixing-bowl.name: Mixing bowls
mixing-bowl.blurb: The kitchen's true supporting cast. You need more than you own, and the day you learn this is the day you buy four.

whisk.name: Whisk
whisk.blurb: Eight wires of persuasion - for emulsions, custards, and rescuing lumpy plans at the last second.

wooden-spoon.name: Wooden spoon
wooden-spoon.blurb: Does not scratch, melt, or conduct heat into your hand - and stirs risotto like it is the job. It is.

spatula.name: Spatula
spatula.blurb: Flexible for fish, firm for flipping. The boundary between cooking and juggling.

tongs.name: Tongs
tongs.blurb: The extension of your hand that does not burn. Flip, toss, lift, serve - then click them twice, for confidence.

ladle.name: Ladle
ladle.blurb: For serving soup and for feeding hot stock into risotto one slow circle at a time.

colander.name: Colander
colander.blurb: The pasta's exit strategy. Also rinses chickpeas, drains noodles, and holds fruit at a picnic.

fine-sieve.name: Fine-mesh sieve
fine-sieve.blurb: The difference between sauce and silk - and the bodyguard of every custard ever made.

spider.name: Spider / skimmer
spider.blurb: A basket on a stick for lifting things out of hot oil or blanching water without bringing the bath with them.

citrus-juicer.name: Citrus squeezer
citrus-juicer.blurb: Half a lemon's juice hides. This finds all of it, seeds staying behind where they belong.

mortar-pestle.name: Mortar & pestle
mortar-pestle.blurb: Crushing releases oils that grinding cannot reach. The oldest machine in the kitchen, still undefeated.

bench-scraper.name: Bench scraper
bench-scraper.blurb: Dough handler, board cleaner, and the smash burger's secret weapon. Three tools in a flat metal lie.

pastry-brush.name: Pastry brush
pastry-brush.blurb: Egg wash, melted butter, glaze - the difference between pale and golden is one swipe.

kitchen-twine.name: Kitchen twine
kitchen-twine.blurb: Ties roasts, trusses poultry and holds the bouquet garni together while it lectures the pot.

potato-masher.name: Potato masher
potato-masher.blurb: For roofs with texture. Machines make glue; arms make mash.

meat-mallet.name: Meat mallet
meat-mallet.blurb: One side spikes, one side flattens. Even thickness is the whole secret of cutlets that cook at the same speed.

rolling-pin.name: Rolling pin
rolling-pin.blurb: Even thickness or bust - a crust is only as honest as its thinnest spot.

pie-dish.name: Pie dish
pie-dish.blurb: Glass shows you the crust's underside; ceramic browns it harder. Either way, the crimp is yours to live with.

sheet-pan.name: Sheet pan
sheet-pan.blurb: The kitchen's stage: roasting, broiling, proofing, catching drips, feeding a crowd at midnight.

wire-rack.name: Wire rack
wire-rack.blurb: Air under fried things keeps the bottom crisp. Steam is the enemy of everything you just worked for.

pizza-stone.name: Pizza stone / steel
pizza-stone.blurb: Pre-heated mass that plays the floor of a bread oven. The leopard-spotted blister comes from here, not from hope.

food-processor.name: Food processor
food-processor.blurb: Blades do in eight seconds what knives do in eight minutes. Falafel paste is its hometown.

blender.name: Blender
blender.blurb: For sauces that must be silk, not texture. Butter chicken's quiet hero, standing behind the marinade.

immersion-blender.name: Immersion blender
immersion-blender.blurb: Purees soup in the pot. One less thing to wash, one more thing to love.

stand-mixer.name: Stand mixer
stand-mixer.blurb: Kneads while you read. Strictly optional, but so is sleep.

rice-cooker.name: Rice cooker
rice-cooker.blurb: Click, forget, perfect. The most honest appliance in the kitchen - it tells you exactly when it is done.
